title: ModernTools
description: Bundles a bunch of different features and options into one utility mod
body:
---
## Overview

**ModernTools** is a lightweight utility bundle designed to streamline your modded experience. Instead of manually installing multiple individual utilities, this mod combines several essential features into one cohesive package. 

Every feature is fully toggleable and configurable using **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config**.

## Included Utilities & Credits

This project bundles and modifies the following mods to ensure they work seamlessly together:

* **[Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders)** – Created by Kira-NT
* **[Quick Pack](https://modrinth.com/mod/quick-pack)** – Created by DrexHD
* **[Language Reload](https://modrinth.com/mod/language-reload)** – Created by Jerozgen
* **[Fast Quit](https://modrinth.com/mod/fastquit)** – Created by contaria

---

**Note:** This mod uses modified or forked versions of the projects listed above to ensure compatibility within a single mod file.

**Notice to Original Mod Authors:** If you are an author of one of the bundled mods and wish to have your code removed from ModernTools, please let me know by opening an issue on the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Jeannuar16/ModernTools/issues) page.
